stories.title: Week 2 preview: Ohio State-Texas leads SEC-Big Ten showdowns, plus five huge Big 12 games
stories.summary: Bluebloods have a chance at the early-season's biggest win. Big 12 and SEC have early conference challenges, and the G6 has an elimination weekend.

stories.title: Sources: Packers, TE Kraft reach 4-year extension worth up to $92M
stories.summary: The Packers and tight end Tucker Kraft have reached agreement on a four-year extension worth up to $92 million, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: 'Embarrassed for them': Drinkwitz rips Kansas for Border War 'crap'
stories.summary: Missouri coach Eli Drinkwitz had plenty to say after beating Kansas on Friday night, saying he was "embarrassed" for the Jayhawks for leaning into the historic nature of the Border War rivalry.

stories.title: Sources: Raiders TE Mayer lands $45M extension as Bowers sidelined
stories.summary: Tight end Michael Mayer, who is stepping in for an injured Brock Bowers to start the regular season, has received a multiyear extension from the Raiders.

stories.title: Poll: Ducks' Moore runaway QB1 in deep crop for 2027 NFL draft
stories.summary: Oregon's Dante Moore is the runaway top vote-getter among 25 NFL scouts and executives polled by ESPN to see whom they project as the top quarterback for the 2027 draft.
